jobs.title: Explicit capture and approved inbox writes
acceptance: Remember-this previews editable scope, memory type, source and retention
Exact path/content/precondition approval is separate from reading or recalling
Concurrent changes, restart and duplicate requests never silently overwrite human notes

jobs.title: Correction, deletion, encryption and restore lifecycle
acceptance: Deletion/revocation removes or blocks all current dependent projections with a receipt
Temporary unavailability is distinguished from deletion
Restored backups reapply tombstones/grants; residual retention and key custody are explicit

Report recall, irrelevant context, latency and permission leakage separately
Keep answer keys outside request context; no new model experiment implied

jobs.title: One optional temporal/semantic adapter decision
acceptance: Pin chosen implementation, dependencies, model/service terms and egress settings before adoption
Provenance, review status and deletion survive an adapter round-trip
Reject complexity without measured benefit; do not reroute the blocked model operation

jobs.title: Structured attachment ingestion
acceptance: Supported documents retain page/block provenance and deterministic parser version
Tables/layout require quality checks; unsupported files remain explicit
No embedded code runs and removal invalidates derived indexes

jobs.title: Explicit vault sync and local host lifecycle
acceptance: One deliberate sync client per device, tested conflicts and exclusions
Live SQLite ledger is not synced as ordinary vault files
Offline/reconnect, stop, restore and last-confirmed source status remain visible

jobs.title: Commitment and procedure-aware attention
acceptance: Reviewed commitments can nominate reminders or proposals with explicit reasons
No retrieved procedure text executes or expands capability grants
Routine budgets, silence/interrupt choices, pause and actual outcomes are inspectable

jobs.title: One official account workflow
acceptance: Consented read-only test account keeps canonical source IDs and freshness
Optional later harmless write uses exact approval and capability-specific reconciliation
OAuth refresh/revocation never expose connector secrets to a model or public repo

jobs.title: Voice, truthful console graph and specialist contracts
acceptance: Preserve concurrent console work and display actual scoped graph/review states
Visible push-to-talk distinguishes generated, played and acknowledged audio
Read actual ENDSTATE/Noir/device contracts; no simulation-to-observation or readiness claims
